title: Supplied Example 5-a — ERP diagnostic transcript
reference: Multiple processes are discussed; no invented sequential link between independent topics.
Production planning uses Excel/paper and experience; Directo does not produce the plan or optimize sequence.
Batch-picking FIFO is imperfect; system-enforced FEFO is a future idea.
Existing sales entry uses retail portals/Directo manually; EDI is not automatic.
Preserve samples/quality hold/optional lab and nonconforming supplier return without inventing an accepted-release route.

Raw-material movement from reception to production and finished-goods logistics to retail chains are explicitly not mapped; do not invent receipt/posting, dispatch, transport documents or customer receipt.
Payroll is Merit Palk; detailed personnel, intercompany store flow, management reports and cloud continuity are not fully mapped.
Do not turn small talk or phone-answering jokes into requirements; keep ambiguous speakers unknown.
